scientific_integrity: Exact all-length combinatorial argument independently cross-checked against small instances and a separate coefficient recurrence; finite testing is not the proof. No external or independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed binary alphabet, one shared cyclic cut per input word, indexed words rather than rotation orbits; no corresponding result for larger alphabets or target-dependent cuts. Possible undiscovered equivalent enumeration in symbolic dynamics or cyclic run statistics.
title: Exact circular subsequence-universality distribution of binary words
